dedupe_keys.name: meteor nepal flood hazard map fluvial undefended for return periods of 1 in 5 10 20 50 75 100 200 250 500 and 1000 years

description: METEOR deposits ten modelled river-flood depth layers for Nepal without representing flood defences. SSBN Ltd (Fathom) is named as producer. The public ODbL 1.0 GeoTIFF inventory covers 5 through 1000-year return periods, including 250 years, at a stated 3-arcsecond WGS84 grid. Zenodo says depths are metres and reflect local event maxima from a two-dimensional shallow-water model built with MERIT terrain and hydrography. A modeller could use the layers as hazard inputs in national infrastructure simulation scenarios for transport and power-asset exposure to undefended river flooding. The related catalogue METEOR Nepal record concerns landslides; these river-flood maps are a separate resource. A limitation is that an undefended assumption is not a map of actual levee condition or the probability of infrastructure failure. The provider says the regional or global inputs are insufficient for detailed local engineering. No GeoTIFF was downloaded, and inundation boundaries were not compared with observed events.
